model_scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled dual-gate stack
model_scope.purpose: Isolate the P1 top-to-bottom electrostatic-coupling allocation ratio at fixed total parallel-plate coupling and fixed physical geometry.
fixed_variables: top gate is the primary swept gate and bottom gate is fixed at 0 V
Ctop+Cbottom parallel-plate proxy is fixed at twice the symmetric T02-C value
top and bottom physical dielectric thicknesses remain 30 nm
channel length = 10 um, width = 60 um, and channel thickness = 24 nm
source voltage = 0 V and drain voltage = 0.01 V
no traps, recombination, ferroelectric polarization, or non-ideal contacts
prohibited_work: physical dielectric-thickness or common-mode dielectric-constant scan
trap, contact, channel-geometry, temperature, or mobility scan
any P2, P3, P4, or P5 run
experimental fitting or calibrated dual-gate prediction
physical capacitance, dielectric constant, Ion, mobility, or uncertainty claims
compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, or HZO work

ratio_encoding.parallel_plate_definition: C per area is proportional to epsilon_r / physical_thickness

p1_p4_variable_ownership.p1_variable: dimensionless differential allocation ratio Ctop/Cbottom generated from one scalar while Ctop+Cbottom is fixed
p1_p4_variable_ownership.encoding_note: The paired region permittivities are numerical electrostatic coupling coefficients. They do not assert that one fabricated Al2O3 layer has a measured bulk permittivity different from the other.
p1_p4_variable_ownership.boundary: P4 owns physical geometry and common-mode dielectric changes; P1 owns only this fixed-sum differential coupling allocation.

current_projection.cell_center_reduction: arithmetic mean of the three element-node vectors

evidence_boundary_is_numerical_p1_only.detail: T03-P1-CAP-RATIO may establish a reproducible five-point fixed-total-coupling allocation-ratio sensitivity for the frozen E2 teaching model; together with the passed P1-BIAS substage it may complete only the numerical P1 group after simulation and independent evidence both pass.

limitations: All VTH, Delta VTH, gm, current, potential, and density values are numerical proxies from the frozen E2 teaching model.
The paired dielectric-region values encode a fixed-sum electrostatic allocation ratio and are not measured Al2O3 material properties or a fabricated asymmetric stack.
Passing this run may complete only numerical P1 together with P1-BIAS; P2, P3, P5, complete T03, experiment calibration, compact models, circuits, layouts, and HZO remain incomplete.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: T03-P1-CAP-RATIO may establish a reproducible five-point fixed-total-coupling allocation-ratio sensitivity for the frozen E2 teaching model; together with the passed P1-BIAS substage it may complete only the numerical P1 group after simulation and independent evidence both pass.
prohibited_claims: measured or physically extracted top-to-bottom capacitance ratio
measured Al2O3 dielectric constants or fabricated asymmetric stack
experimentally calibrated dual-gate response or process distribution
physical Ion, mobility, hysteresis, or parameter uncertainty
trap, contact, geometry, temperature, ferroelectric, compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only contract PASS permits this run. Simulation plus independent persisted-evidence PASS completes numerical P1, after which exactly one of P2, P3, or P5 may be frozen next.
